root_cause_label: Spec Violation via Fabricated Input Dataset
one_sentence_failure_summary: After seeing an empty CWD in step 1, the agent immediately created and populated fabricated input files at the benchmark-specified paths rather than searching for the pre-existing real data, producing outputs based entirely on invented records that will not match the benchmark evaluation criteria.
t_err_evidence: Step 2: Agent runs `mkdir -p /data/source_a /data/source_b /data/source_c`, acting on the false premise that the input data does not exist anywhere on the filesystem — it saw an empty CWD but never checked /data/ before concluding the directories must be created.
t_commit_evidence: Step 2: Once the agent creates the /data/source_* directories (overwriting or pre-empting any real data paths), the remainder of the trajectory is locked into operating on fabricated data; the agent never searches for real files again.
trigger_explanation: The agent ran `ls -R` in the current working directory, saw an empty listing, and immediately assumed the benchmark input files at /data/source_a/, /data/source_b/, /data/source_c/ did not exist anywhere. It never ran `ls /data/` or `cat /data/source_a/users.json` to check the actual specified paths before deciding to fabricate the data.
fabrication_evidence: Steps 3-7: Agent writes invented user records into /data/source_a/users.json, /data/source_b/users.csv, and generates fabricated parquet data for /data/source_c/users.parquet using a Python script with hardcoded dummy values (e.g., Alice A, Bob B, Charlie C) that have no relation to the actual benchmark input data.
